correctness.rationale: The branch update maps are derived directly from the EF recurrence. Any 11 transmission block annihilates the full state and yields a geometric absorption tail. Conditioning on the first transmission gives an exact renewal equation with nonnegative kernel, whose generating function is rational. Positivity at all kernel degrees at least two proves a unique positive, simple, strictly dominant pole, giving exact all-parameter geometric mean-square regimes. The factorization at p=2/3 gives limiting multiplier 2/5. The p=1 boundary is explicitly handled. Independent exact-rational enumeration and symbolic identities in verify.py corroborate these claims but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The identity-or-zero random compressor and accumulated error memory are natural, published constructions for intermittent communication. The exact 2/3 threshold decides whether a standard expected-squared-error performance criterion is usable, while finite-time almost-sure success misleadingly holds for every positive p. The positive critical error floor and exponential rare-event growth are nontrivial structural boundaries, not a normalization or an arbitrary parameter slice. The result is explicitly limited to the exact-step scalar benchmark; it does not claim a general convergence theorem.
